stories.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT
stories.take: Thrive Holdings is buying ADT for $15.3 billion and plans to bring AI into home security — OpenAI's orbit keeps expanding into physical-world businesses.

stories.title: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity
stories.take: Mistral open-sourced its trillion-parameter 'Le Chonk,' claiming it matches or beats China's best open models on coding and cybersecurity — and gives defenders control closed models can't.

stories.title: A Defense Contractor Gave Their Personal AI Agent Access to a Secure Pentagon System
stories.take: An Accenture employee's personal Claude agent ran on a secure DoD network for two months before anyone noticed — the agent-access problem is no longer theoretical.

stories.title: Report: Trump did nothing with intel that China planted spy close to Nvidia CEO
stories.take: US intelligence believes a Singapore AI-cloud exec close to Jensen Huang was funneling secrets to China — and a new report says Trump sat on the intel.

stories.title: Google admits AI search makes less money, but it's fixing that with more ads
stories.take: Alphabet's Q3 fallout deepens: AI search earns less than classic search, free cash flow swung to -$9.06 billion, and Google's fix is more ads in AI results.

stories.title: Polymarket Halted International Trading After Hackers Drained Accounts
stories.take: Hackers drained trader accounts through a compromised third-party provider; Polymarket paused international trading, has resumed, and says victims will be made whole.

stories.title: Kalshi and its co-founders face felony charges for violating Utah gambling laws
stories.take: Utah filed felony charges against Kalshi and its co-founders over its total gambling ban — even as the Trump administration sues Utah to save the prediction market.

stories.title: Bluesky blocks links to leaked DHS employee data as government seeks takedowns
stories.take: Follow-up to this morning's leak story: Bluesky is blocking links to the archive naming 41,000 DHS workers and undercover ICE agents, drawing criticism as the government seeks takedowns.

stories.title: Google’s AI overhaul of search hits snags as ad revenue growth cools
stories.take: Google's core ad growth decelerated in Q3 even as AI features drove more queries — the AI search transition is raising volume faster than revenue.

stories.title: Meta says expanded AI processing capacity is driving ad results
stories.take: Meta says beefed-up processing capacity behind its AI ad systems is lifting clicks and conversions — infrastructure as a marketing pitch to advertisers.

stories.title: Cash Flow, Not Capex, Is the Metric Investors Care About in Big Tech Earnings
stories.take: This earnings season, investors are rewarding positive cash flow and punishing cash burn — capex bragging rights matter less than they did a year ago.

stories.title: The Four Down and Dirtiest Political Ads of the 2026 Midterms
stories.take: With voting less than a week away, Adweek rounds up the ugliest ads of the cycle — and they are, in its words, uglier than ever.

stories.title: Warner Bros. chases ‘Cat in the Hat’ across Amazon’s ad ecosystem
stories.take: Warner Bros. is promoting 'Cat in the Hat' across Amazon's whole ad ecosystem — a mobile minigame, Alexa integration, and placements on Twitch, Prime Video and IMDb.

stories.title: Mass Effect 5 art director says it's “truly heartbreaking” we'll never play his team's game
stories.take: Mass Effect 5's art director calls BioWare's closure 'truly heartbreaking' — a whole team's work will never reach players.

stories.title: Maxon teases another AI tool, and artists aren't happy, despite not knowing what it does yet
stories.take: Maxon teased a new AI tool for Cinema 4D and artists reacted badly before knowing what it does — a sign of how deep creative-software AI fatigue now runs.

stories.title: Timberwolves' Edwards undergoes successful knee scope
stories.take: Anthony Edwards had a 'successful' arthroscopic procedure on his right knee at the Mayo Clinic on Thursday — a big absence for Minnesota to manage.

stories.title: Five ways the NBA's injury outbreak could reshape trade season
stories.take: Barely a week in, the sidelined-star list keeps growing — CBS breaks down how the injury wave could reshape trade season, with OKC under pressure and Houston holding cards.

stories.title: Victor Wembanyama on 60 Minutes: Spurs star explains why 'villain' label didn't bother him during NBA Finals
stories.take: Wembanyama tells 60 Minutes (airing Sunday) the 'villain' label from the Finals didn't bother him — the full interview lands this weekend.

stories.title: Hornets bench Reid at half for not meeting 'our standards'
stories.take: Charlotte benched newly acquired Naz Reid at halftime of Wednesday's loss to Detroit for not meeting team standards — an early, public message.

stories.title: Kerr, Finch want NBA to alter how it calls flopping techs
stories.take: Steve Kerr and Chris Finch both want the league to rethink flopping technicals and focus more on offensive flops.

stories.title: Inside the stunning 72-hour Lakers sale and the uncertainty that still looms
stories.take: ESPN reconstructs the secret 72 hours in which Mark Walter flipped the Lakers — and the Buss sibling bickering the sale reignited.

stories.title: Celtics star Jayson Tatum says he's 'starting to feel like my old self' again after hitting game-winner
stories.take: A year and a half after his torn Achilles, Tatum hit a game-winner and says he's starting to feel like his old self again.

stories.title: Brewers set World Series parade for Friday, two days after winning 2026 title
stories.take: Milwaukee's Parade of Champions is set for Friday, two days after the Brewers won the franchise's first title.

stories.title: Ranking the top 50 MLB free agents for the 2026-27 offseason, plus landing spots for every player
stories.take: The offseason board is set: CBS ranks the top 50 free agents with landing spots for each — with Tarik Skubal's next deal (Dodgers reunion? richest ever?) the headline question.

stories.title: MLB Lockout 101: Everything to know about baseball's likely upcoming work stoppage
stories.take: Enjoy the parade glow while it lasts: a lockout is very likely in early December, and CBS lays out how the stoppage would work.

stories.title: Three reasons why the Brewers can repeat as World Series champions in 2027
stories.take: Fresh off their first title, the Brewers are 'nowhere close to done' — three reasons a repeat is realistic.

stories.title: Champion Brewers trail Dodgers in '27 World Series title odds
stories.take: Oddsmakers still favor the Dodgers for 2027, with the champion Brewers just behind them in the early odds.

stories.title: Brewers' Murphy rips Yankees in viral celebratory exchange with Bauers
stories.take: Pat Murphy was caught calling the Yankees 'horseshit' in a viral celebration clip with Jake Bauers — the champs are not being gracious about New York.

stories.title: Offseason questions for eliminated teams: What's next for Rays after World Series defeat
stories.take: For Tampa Bay, the winter starts with payroll and Junior Caminero questions after an unexpected run ended in the World Series.

stories.title: US economy grows faster than expected but inflation rises to 3.7%
stories.take: Q3 GDP grew at a brisk 3.4% pace on consumer spending and AI investment — but inflation accelerated to 3.7% in September, days before the midterms.

stories.title: Trump calls for prosecution of Mary Peltola as Alaska campaign turmoil grows
stories.take: Trump called the Alaska Senate situation 'voter fraud at the highest level' at a South Carolina rally and again demanded Peltola's prosecution as the governor-ordered probe roils the race.

stories.title: Judge blocks Trump administration's Medicaid work requirement rule forcing proof of medical frailty
stories.take: A federal judge blocked the administration's Medicaid work-requirement rule; 25 states had sued over the CMS guidance tied to the 'One Big Beautiful Bill.'

stories.title: JD Vance letter may offer last chance to avert fresh conflict between US and Iran
stories.take: Vance wrote personally to Iran's top security official — a sign Washington hasn't abandoned diplomacy, with hopes of averting a new conflict resting on Tehran's reply.

stories.title: Seven oil tankers carrying 288,000 tonnes of Russian diesel sail towards US
stories.take: Seven tankers with 288,000 tonnes of Russian diesel — the first phase of the Trump-Putin deal, tracked by Greenpeace — are sailing toward the US, though unloading is uncertain.

stories.title: Israeli leader Netanyahu accused of using ‘ugly’ smear tactics to cling to power
stories.take: After his coalition lost its majority, Netanyahu claimed Arab Israeli parties 'stole' the election with foreign backing — opponents call it an ugly smear to cling to power.

stories.title: Spain begins mourning period as search continues for train crash victims
stories.take: Spain began three days of mourning for at least 69 people killed in a high-speed train crash, as crews, drones and dog units keep searching the wreckage.

stories.title: FTC orders Delta, Uber and others to hand over data on algorithmic pricing
stories.take: The FTC is demanding airlines, ride-share firms and retailers explain how algorithms and loyalty programs let them charge different prices for the same product.

stories.title: Judge: 'mountain of evidence' ICE agents discriminated against Latinos
stories.take: A federal judge found a 'mountain of evidence' — agents' own testimony and body-cam footage — of an unwritten ICE policy targeting Latino, working-class people, and blocked the racial-profiling stops.

stories.title: California High Speed Rail Authority boss Ian Choudri resigns under fire
stories.take: High-speed rail CEO Ian Choudri resigned abruptly ahead of a critical board vote on a key route segment, under fire over a travel-expenses scandal.

stories.title: Dark and stormy weather coming to SoCal, just in time for Halloween
stories.take: A dark and stormy Halloween is on tap for the LA area, with rain expected Friday through Sunday.

stories.title: SoCal coast braces for more flooding as El Niño's high tides break records
stories.take: Flood advisories now run through 2 p.m. Friday for all SoCal coastal counties as El Niño's record high tides keep swamping the coast.

stories.title: Homelessness declines, but still up over Newsom’s two terms
stories.take: California's homeless count is declining — but it is still higher than when Newsom took office, per the latest WhatMatters tally.

stories.title: Raman leads among younger voters, polls show, but Bass isn't conceding any ground
stories.take: Nithya Raman leads big among younger voters in the LA mayoral race, but Karen Bass is courting them too and says she'll 'be here waiting for them after I win.'

stories.title: California man who allegedly beat elderly woman with bat captured in Oklahoma
stories.take: San Bernardino County detectives captured Erik Navarro, 26, in Oklahoma; he's accused of beating an elderly woman with a bat and faces robbery, elder-injury and assault charges.

stories.title: A Plan for Two Dans: How Democrats Manipulated Alaska’s Ballot
stories.take: The answer: Peltola's aides, fearing a Republican spoiler, struck first — operative Jared Kurtz (sometimes using the name 'Zane') recruited Petersburg's Dan J. Sullivan to run against Sen. Dan S. Sullivan and split confused Republican votes • A fired campaign manager blew the whistle, and the Alaska Supreme Court has already ruled both Dans can stay on the ballot • The race could decide Senate control, and Trump is demanding Peltola's prosecution

stories.title: Texas Talarico freakout
stories.take: Why the freakout: James Talarico — a faith-forward seminarian and teacher — leads most polls in a state that hasn't elected a Democratic senator since 1988 • Ken Paxton is corruption-dogged, needs independents focused on cost of living, and Trump's Texas approval sits around 32% • GOP attacks call Talarico both too soft ('Low-T') and a dangerous radical, a contradiction that blunts both

stories.title: Dolores Huerta, powerful-yet-flawed labor leader, dies at 96
stories.take: Huerta's legacy: co-founding the farm worker movement, winning the law that gave farm workers union rights, health insurance and pensions, and coining 'Sí, se puede' • The flawed side: this year she revealed Cesar Chavez raped her nearly 60 years ago and she stayed silent to protect the movement; critics say she also did too little for women in the union • Also in the episode: an LA rabbi detained in the West Bank and the LA city attorney race

stories.title: The AI Rankings Just Got Reshuffled
stories.take: The answer: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon tops the new Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index V5 at 59 points, ahead of Opus 5.5 (58) and GPT-6 Astra (57, up from sixth); Sonnet 5.5 fell to fourth and Kimi K3.1 Pro to ninth • V5 moves to mostly private benchmarks (60%) to curb benchmark-maxing, and the open-weights gap widened from 3 to 12 points • Also: the DOJ is probing Nvidia's $13 billion Hugging Face acquisition

stories.title: Google Erases a Record $500 Billion as AI Eats Into Sales
stories.take: Alphabet fell as much as 14% intraday as AI summaries eat search clicks and ad monetization lags the shift to AI mode • Microsoft held up on 48% cloud growth, and Caterpillar has become the industrial AI proxy with data-center equipment orders up 35% quarter over quarter • Meta's Muse is named as a share threat while Gemini is described as not yet at the frontier

stories.title: What Wall Street Really Thinks About the AI Trade Now
stories.take: The answer: Wall Street is still overwhelmingly bullish on AI — Barclays' Alex Altman calls the current phase 'denial' on the bubble chart • The crack is at the periphery: neoclouds can't fund themselves like cash-rich hyperscalers, and Cipher's stumble already spilled into CoreWeave bonds • In his telling, the trade only breaks if a hyperscaler actually reins in capex

stories.title: At The Money: Preparing for a Career During in Age of Artificial Intelligence
stories.take: AI will take the routine tasks, so new graduates must build critical thinking and learn to interrogate AI outputs instead of relying on rote knowledge • Mastering AI tools is this generation's equivalent of mastering the spreadsheet — and everyone needs a distinctive 'superpower' skill • About 50% of Harvard Business School graduates eventually go entrepreneurial, and roughly 80% of entrepreneurs end up far from their original idea

stories.title: The Summit of Steves: Share & Doppelgänger & Tell (Halloween Edition) with Michael Cruz Kayne and Katie Nolan
stories.take: The 'Bizarro Steve Kerr' is Steve Gillis, a Las Vegas English teacher and volleyball coach who insists the resemblance just happens — though he was carrying Kerr's No. 25 jersey and a Sharpie • Roger Federer once took a selfie with Gillis, apparently mistaking him for Kerr • Pablo put both Steves in a group chat ('Steve, we finally meet,' Kerr replied) and it's now the most active chat in his phone

stories.title: Elder Scrolls 6 Reveal Coming Soon?! - Kinda Funny Games Daily 10.29.26
stories.take: The answer: there is no confirmed reveal — only an unconfirmed report (via The Verge and VGC) that the game is called The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel, set in Hammerfell, and could be announced as soon as next month around Skyrim's 15th anniversary on Nov. 11 • The hosts judge it plausible but unproven, possibly an Xbox proof-of-life move, and expect 2028 at the earliest • Also: FromSoftware's The Duskbloods delayed to 2027, and Celeste pulled from Xbox in support of BDS
